title: A credit dated on the as-of date stays in the same bucket as before
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an unused credit memo {Credit-memo-A} dated {Date-A}; before the release you noted which A/R Detail bucket it was in with {Date-A} as the as-of date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST REL-08 Same Day Credit; {Date-A} is the day before the release.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Date-A} as the as-of date and {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it is in the same bucket as before the release (today that is "1-30 days past due"): this release does not change how credits are aged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
